# Allegri confirms 20-man Napoli squad for Monza clash with two absences

Originally posted on Football Italia  |  By Peter Young  |  Last updated Oct 27, 2026 11:08 AM ET

Google   Add us as a preferred source on Google [...] Napoli also confirmed on Monday that Rrahmani has returned to full training with the first-team group, but that summer signing Badiashile is facing around a month out with a rectus femoris injury and that Leonardo Spinazzola will miss the Monza game with a minor thigh issue.

It is a case of one in, two out, as Rrahmani returns to the matchday squad while Badiashile and Spinazzola drop out.
